en.t: The Senate of Rome says that Caesar will be declared a public enemy unless he disbands his army, prompting the tribunes who support him to flee to where Caesar is waiting in Ravenna
en.s: The Senate was the governing and advisory assembly of the aristocracy in the ancient Roman Republic. It was not an elected body, but one whose members were appointed by the consuls, and later by the censors, which were appointed by the aristocratic Centuriate Assembly. After a Roman magistrate served his term in office, it usually was followed with automatic appointment to the Senate.

zh.t: 罗马元老院要求恺撒解散军队，否则将宣布他为公敌；支持他的保民官逃往他驻守的拉文纳
zh.s: 元老院是古罗马共和国贵族阶层的治理和议事机构。其成员并非选举产生，而是由执政官任命，后来改由监察官任命；监察官则由贵族控制的森都利亚大会选出。罗马高级官员任期结束后，通常会自动获得元老院席位。

en.t: Afonso IV becomes King of Portugal
en.s: Afonso IV (Afonso Dinis; 8 February 1291 – 28 May 1357), called the Brave (Portuguese: o Bravo), was King of Portugal from 1325 until his death in 1357. He was the only legitimate son of King Denis of Portugal and Elizabeth of Aragon.

zh.t: 阿方索四世成为葡萄牙国王
zh.s: 阿方索四世本名阿方索·迪尼斯，生于1291年2月8日，卒于1357年5月28日，绰号“勇敢者”（葡萄牙语：o Bravo）。他自1325年起担任葡萄牙国王，直至1357年去世。他是葡萄牙国王迪尼斯与阿拉贡的伊莎贝尔唯一的婚生儿子。

en.s: The Bajaur massacre or Battle of Bajaur was a military conflict waged by Babur against the Gabari Swati tribe inhabiting the Bajaur region, on 6–7 January 1519. Babur, a Timurid (and later Mughal) ruler from Fergana (in present-day Uzbekistan) who captured Kabul in 1504, launched this assault with the purpose of solidifying his authority in the Kabulistan.

zh.s: 巴焦尔屠杀又称巴焦尔战役，是巴布尔于1519年1月6日至7日对居住在巴焦尔地区的加巴里·斯瓦蒂部族展开的一场军事冲突。巴布尔来自费尔干纳（今乌兹别克斯坦），属于帖木儿王朝，后来成为莫卧儿王朝统治者。他于1504年攻占喀布尔，此次进攻旨在巩固自己在喀布尔斯坦的统治。

en.s: The Conquest of Fez or Capture of Fez took place in 1554 between the Algerian forces of Salah Rais and the ruler of the Saadi Sultanate, Mohammed ash-Sheikh. The battle took place on 7 January at Qudyat-al-Mahali, a suburb near Fez and occurred after Salah Reis’ two previous victories against the Saadians, one at Taza and another at the Sebou river.

en.t: French troops, led by Francis, Duke of Guise, take Calais, the last continental possession of England
en.s: The French siege of Calais in early 1558 was part of the Italian War of 1551–1559 between France and England and their respective allies. It resulted in the seizure of the town and its dependencies by France. The Pale of Calais had been ruled by England since 1347, during the Hundred Years' War. By the 1550s, England was ruled by Mary I and her husband Philip II of Spain.

zh.t: 吉斯公爵弗朗索瓦率法军攻占英格兰在欧洲大陆的最后领地加来
zh.s: 1558年初的加来围城战是1551—1559年意大利战争的一部分，交战双方是法国、英格兰及其各自的盟友。法国最终夺取加来及其附属地区。加来辖区自百年战争期间的1347年起由英格兰统治。到了16世纪50年代，英格兰由玛丽一世及其丈夫、西班牙国王腓力二世共同统治。

en.s: The Battle of Catirai was a battle that took place on January 7, 1569, in the Catirai region in Chile during the Arauco War. The battle was fought between Mapuche forces led by the chieftains Llanganabal and Millalelmo, and forces of the Spanish Empire led by General Martín Ruiz de Gamboa, and it resulted in a Mapuche victory.

zh.s: 1569年1月7日，阿劳科战争中的卡蒂赖战役在智利卡蒂赖地区展开。扬加纳瓦尔和米亚莱尔莫两位首领率领马普切军队，迎战马丁·鲁伊斯·德·甘博亚将军指挥的西班牙帝国军队，最终马普切人获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Wenden (also known as Battle of Kieś) took place on January 7, 1601, during the Polish–Swedish War (1600–1611). Polish-Lithuanian forces were led by Jürgen von Farensbach (Jerzy Farensbach) and Maciej Dębiński. The Swedes were under Hans Bengtsson. The battle is significant as the first encounter between Swedish reiters and Polish hussars.

zh.s: 1601年1月7日，1600—1611年波瑞战争中的温登战役爆发，也称凯希战役。波兰—立陶宛军队由于尔根·冯·法伦斯巴赫，又称耶日·法伦斯巴赫，以及马切伊·登宾斯基率领，瑞军则由汉斯·本特松指挥。这是瑞典手枪骑兵与波兰翼骑兵首次交战。

en.s: The Jamestown settlement in the Colony of Virginia was the first permanent English settlement in the Americas. It was located, in what later became James City County, on the northeast bank of the James River, about 2.5 mi (4 km) southwest of present-day Williamsburg. It was established by the Virginia Company of London as "James Fort" on May 4, 1607 O.S. (May 14, 1607 N.S.).

zh.t: 弗吉尼亚的詹姆斯敦遭大火焚毁
zh.s: 弗吉尼亚殖民地的詹姆斯敦是英国人在美洲建立的首个永久定居点。它位于詹姆斯河东北岸，后属詹姆斯城县，距今天的威廉斯堡西南约2.5英里（4公里）。伦敦弗吉尼亚公司于1607年5月4日（旧历，即新历5月14日）建立了这处定居点，最初称为“詹姆斯堡”。

en.s: Callisto ( kə-LIST-oh) is the second-largest moon of Jupiter, after Ganymede. It is also the third-largest moon in the Solar System, following Ganymede and Saturn's moon Titan, and nearly as large as the planet Mercury, but only about a third of that planet's mass. With a diameter of 4,821 km, Callisto is roughly a third larger than Earth's Moon and orbits Jupiter on average at a distance of 1.883 million km, which is about five times further out than the Moon orbiting Earth.

zh.s: 木卫四（Callisto）是木星仅次于木卫三的第二大卫星，也是太阳系中仅次于木卫三和土卫六的第三大卫星。它的体积几乎与水星相当，质量却只有水星的约三分之一。木卫四直径为4,821公里，比地球的月球大约三分之一。它与木星的平均距离约为188.3万公里，约是月球与地球距离的五倍。

en.t: The first American commercial bank, the Bank of North America, opens
en.s: The Bank of North America was the first chartered bank in the United States, and served as the country's first de facto central bank. It was chartered by the Congress of the Confederation on May 26, 1781, and opened in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, on January 7, 1782.

zh.t: 美国首家商业银行北美银行开业
zh.s: 北美银行是美国第一家获特许经营的银行，也曾充当美国第一家事实上的中央银行。邦联国会于1781年5月26日授予其特许，银行于1782年1月7日在宾夕法尼亚州费城开业。

en.t: 1788–89 United States presidential election in New Jersey
en.s: A presidential election was held in New Jersey on January 7, 1789, as part of the 1789 United States presidential election. The state legislature chose six representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. New Jersey, which had become the 3rd state on December 18, 1787, unanimously cast its 6 electoral votes for George Washington during its first presidential election.

en.s: The Second Battle of Chuenpi was fought between British and Chinese forces in the Pearl River Delta, Guangdong province, China, on 7 January 1841 during the First Opium War. The British launched an amphibious attack at the Humen strait (Bogue), capturing the forts on the islands of Chuenpi and Taikoktow. Subsequent negotiations between British Plenipotentiary Charles Elliot and Chinese Imperial Commissioner Qishan resulted in the Convention of Chuenpi on 20 January. As one of the terms of the agreement, Elliot announced the cession of Hong Kong Island to the British Empire, after which the British took formal possession of the island on 26 January.

zh.s: 1841年1月7日，第一次鸦片战争期间，英军与清军在广东珠江三角洲交战。英军在虎门海峡发动两栖攻击，夺取穿鼻和大角两地炮台。此后，英国全权代表义律与清朝钦差大臣琦善谈判，于1月20日议定《穿鼻草约》。义律宣布，协议条款之一是将香港岛割让英国，英军随后于1月26日正式占领该岛。

en.s: The 1856 City of Toronto Municipal Election was the city's 22nd municipal election. Polling occurred on the first Monday and Tuesday of the year, January 7 and 8. Elections for Aldermen and Councilmen were held in seven wards and for the Municipal License Inspector. After the election, John Beverley Robinson a member of the family compact and strong supporter of the railroads, was elected Mayor by City Council, beating John Hutchison a Toronto merchant, who had a reputation for opposing corruption.

zh.s: 1856年多伦多市政选举是该市第22次市政选举，投票于当年的第一个星期一和星期二，即1月7日和8日举行。七个选区选出了市参事和市议员，同时还选举了市政执照检查员。选举后，市议会推选“家族统治集团”（Family Compact）成员、铁路建设的坚定支持者约翰·贝弗利·罗宾逊为市长，他击败了以反腐败著称的多伦多商人约翰·哈奇森。

en.s: The Kingstree jail fire killed 22 prisoners on the evening of Monday, January 7, 1867, in the Williamsburg County seat of Kingstree, South Carolina, United States. One white prisoner escaped the building and survived, but all of the African-American prisoners, incarcerated on the third floor, were killed. Attempts to rescue the 19 men and 3 women left in the building were ineffective. By the time action was taken, the billowing smoke and heat were overwhelming. The cause of the fire was never made public. Some sources speculate that the prisoners caused the fire, while others contest this claim.

zh.t: 美国金斯特里监狱火灾
zh.s: 1867年1月7日星期一晚，美国南卡罗来纳州威廉斯堡县县治金斯特里发生监狱火灾，造成22名囚犯死亡。一名白人囚犯逃出建筑幸存，但关押在三楼的所有非裔囚犯均遇难。营救留在楼内的19名男子和三名女子的行动未能奏效，等到采取措施时，浓烟和高温已使人无法接近。起火原因从未公开。一些资料推测火是囚犯所放，另一些资料则反对这一说法。

Acclamation were declared in all seats upon close of nominations on December 31, 1888 so no election was held.

zh.s: 1889年卡尔加里市政选举原定于1月7日举行，选出一名市长及六名议员，组成第五届镇议会，任期从1889年1月21日至1890年1月20日。但在1888年12月31日提名截止时，所有职位均因无人竞争而直接宣布当选，因此没有进行投票。

en.t: Fred Ott’s Sneeze is filmed at Edison’s Black Maria studio
en.s: The short film Fred Ott’s Sneeze was filmed at Edison’s Black Maria studio in West Orange, New Jersey, on 7 January 1894. It shows Edison employee Fred Ott sneezing. William Heise operated the camera, and William K. Laurie Dickson applied for copyright registration.
en.n: The date records filming. The cited catalog describes a copyright application; it does not establish a patent grant on the same day.

zh.t: 短片《弗雷德·奥特打喷嚏》在爱迪生的“黑玛丽亚”摄影棚拍摄
zh.s: 1894年1月7日，短片《弗雷德·奥特打喷嚏》在新泽西州西奥兰治的爱迪生“黑玛丽亚”摄影棚拍摄。影片记录了爱迪生的雇员弗雷德·奥特打喷嚏的画面。威廉·海斯负责摄影，威廉·K.劳里·迪克森申请了版权登记。
zh.n: 此日期记录的是拍摄。所引目录记载的是版权申请，并不能证明同一天获得了专利。

en.s: The Lanzadera Campaign was a significant part of the Cuban War of Independence as it was the next operation of the Mambises by Máximo Gómez to distract Spanish troops to him and avoiding their pressure on Antonio Maceo, who was able to continue to the West to complete the Invasion from East to West in Cuba.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 兰萨德拉战役是古巴独立战争中的一次重要行动。马克西莫·戈麦斯率领古巴独立军吸引西班牙军队的注意，减轻安东尼奥·马塞奥所部的压力，使其得以继续向西推进，完成横贯古巴的东西进军。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Ashburton by-election, 1904 was a parliamentary by-election held in England on 7 January 1904 to elect a new Member of Parliament (MP) for the British House of Commons constituency of Ashburton in Devon. It was triggerred by the death of the sitting Liberal Party MP Charles Seale-Hayne. The election was contested by the Conservative and Liberal parties and won by the Liberal candidate, Harry Trelawney Eve, with a majority of 1,476 votes.

zh.s: 1904年1月7日，英国德文郡阿什伯顿下议院选区举行补选，填补自由党议员查尔斯·西尔-海恩去世后留下的席位。保守党与自由党参与竞争，自由党候选人哈里·特里劳尼·伊夫以1,476票优势获胜。

en.t: Marconi issues a circular prescribing CQD as a radio distress call
en.s: CQD (transmitted in Morse code as ▄▄▄ ▄ ▄▄▄ ▄ ▄▄▄ ▄▄▄ ▄ ▄▄▄ ▄▄▄ ▄ ▄ ) is one of the first distress signals adopted for radio use. On 7 January 1904 the Marconi International Marine Communication Company issued "Circular 57", which specified that, for the company's installations, beginning 1 February 1904 "the call to be given by ships in distress or in any way requiring assistance shall be 'C Q D'".
en.n: The circular was issued on January 7, 1904 and prescribed use beginning February 1. Adoption of SOS at the 1906 convention did not immediately end CQD transmissions.

zh.t: 马可尼公司发布通告，规定使用 CQD 无线电遇险呼号
zh.s: CQD（摩尔斯电码：−·−· −−·− −··）是最早用于无线电通信的遇险信号之一。1904年1月7日，马可尼国际海事通信公司发布第57号通告，规定其公司设备自1904年2月1日起，“船舶遇险或以任何方式需要援助时，应发出 C Q D 呼号”。
zh.n: 通告于1904年1月7日发布，规定自2月1日起使用该呼号。1906年公约采纳 SOS，并不意味着 CQD 随即停止使用。

en.s: The Battle of Mojkovac (Serbian: Бој на Мојковцу, Boj na Mojkovcu) was a World War I battle fought between 6 January and 7 January 1916 near Mojkovac, Montenegro, between the armies of Austria-Hungary and Montenegro. It ended with a Montenegrin victory.

zh.s: 1916年1月6日至7日，第一次世界大战中的奥匈军队与黑山军队，在黑山莫伊科瓦茨附近交战，最终黑山军队获胜。

en.s: The Christmas Uprising or Christmas Rebellion (Montenegrin: Божићна побуна, Božićna pobuna or Божићни устанак, Božićni ustanak) refers to the uprising of Montenegrin guerrilla fighters aimed at overturning the unification of the Kingdom of Montenegro with the Kingdom of Serbia. The uprising occurred in and around the town of Cetinje on 7 January 1919, the day of Orthodox Christmas. The catalyst for the uprising was the decision of the controversial Grand People's Assembly in Montenegro (The Podgorica Parliament) for unconditional unification of Montenegro with the Kingdom of Serbia.

zh.s: 1919年1月7日，东正教圣诞节当天，黑山游击队在采蒂涅及周边发动起义，试图推翻黑山王国与塞尔维亚王国的合并。导火索是备受争议的黑山国民大会，也称波德戈里察议会，决定让黑山无条件并入塞尔维亚。

en.t: The New York State Assembly refuses to seat five duly elected Socialist assemblymen
en.s: The New York State Assembly is the lower house of the New York State Legislature, with the New York State Senate being the upper house. There are 150 seats in the Assembly. Assembly members serve two-year terms without term limits. The Assembly convenes at the State Capitol in Albany.

zh.t: 纽约州众议院拒绝让五名依法当选的社会党议员就职
zh.s: 纽约州众议院是纽约州立法机构的下院，州参议院为上院。众议院有150个席位，议员每届任期两年，未设任期届数限制。该院在奥尔巴尼的州议会大厦开会。

en.s: The 1921 Anglo-Irish Treaty (Irish: An Conradh Angla-Éireannach), commonly known in Ireland as The Treaty and officially the Articles of Agreement for a Treaty Between Great Britain and Ireland, was an agreement between the government of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland and the government of the Irish Republic that concluded the Irish War of Independence.
en.n: Dáil Éireann ratifies the Anglo-Irish Treaty by a 64–57 vote.

zh.s: 1921年《英爱条约》（爱尔兰语：An Conradh Angla-Éireannach）在爱尔兰通常简称《条约》，正式名称为《大不列颠与爱尔兰条约协定条款》。它由大不列颠及爱尔兰联合王国政府与爱尔兰共和国政府达成，结束了爱尔兰独立战争。
zh.n: 爱尔兰议会（Dáil Éireann）以64票赞成、57票反对批准《英爱条约》。

en.s: The 1928 Thames flood was a disastrous flood of the River Thames that affected much of riverside London on 7 January 1928, as well as places further downriver. Fourteen people died and thousands were made homeless when floodwaters poured over the top of the Thames Embankment and part of the Chelsea Embankment collapsed.

zh.s: 1928年1月7日，泰晤士河发生严重洪灾，伦敦沿河大片地区以及更下游的地点受到影响。洪水漫过泰晤士河堤岸，切尔西堤岸也部分坍塌，造成14人死亡，数千人无家可归。

en.s: Guy Lambton Menzies (20 August 1909 – 1 November 1940) was an Australian aviator who flew the first solo trans-Tasman flight, from Sydney, Australia, to the West Coast of New Zealand, on 7 January 1931.

zh.t: 盖伊·孟席斯用11小时45分完成首次单人不间断跨塔斯曼飞行，从澳大利亚飞往新西兰，最后在新西兰西海岸发生迫降事故
zh.s: 盖伊·兰姆顿·孟席斯（Guy Lambton Menzies，1909年8月20日至1940年11月1日）是一名澳大利亚飞行员。1931年1月7日，他从澳大利亚悉尼飞往新西兰西海岸，完成首次单人跨塔斯曼飞行。

en.s: The Battle of Raate Road (Finnish: Raatteen tien taistelu) was fought during the Winter War between the Soviet Union and Finland in January 1940, as a part of the Battle of Suomussalmi. On December 7, 1939, the Soviet 163rd Rifle Division captured Suomussalmi, but found itself trapped deep inside Finnish territory, and the Soviet 44th Rifle Division was sent to aid the 163rd.
en.n: Winter War: Battle of Raate Road: The Finnish 9th Division finally defeat the numerically superior Soviet forces on the Raate-Suomussalmi road.

zh.s: 拉泰公路战役（芬兰语：Raatteen tien taistelu）是1940年1月冬季战争期间苏联与芬兰之间的一场战斗，属于索穆斯萨尔米战役的一部分。1939年12月7日，苏军第163步兵师占领索穆斯萨尔米后，发现自己被困在芬兰腹地；苏军随后派出第44步兵师前往增援。
zh.n: 冬季战争中的拉泰公路战役：芬兰第9师最终击败了拉泰—索穆斯萨尔米公路上兵力数量占优的苏军。

en.s: The Battle of Lyuban, Lyuban offensive operation or Battle of the Volkhov (7 January 1942 – 30 April 1942) (Russian: Любанская наступательная операция; German: Schlacht am Wolchow) was a Soviet offensive operation of World War II. It was conducted by the Volkhov and Leningrad Fronts of the Red Army with the goal of relieving the siege of Leningrad and encircling and destroying the German forces carrying out the siege.

zh.s: 柳班战役，又称柳班进攻战役或沃尔霍夫战役，发生于1942年1月7日至4月30日，是苏联在第二次世界大战期间发起的一次进攻行动。红军沃尔霍夫方面军和列宁格勒方面军实施了这次行动，目标是解除列宁格勒之围，并包围、歼灭实施围城的德军。

en.t: Bombing of Bangkok in World War II
en.s: The city of Bangkok, Thailand was bombed by the Allies on numerous occasions during World War II because of its strategic importance as the logistic and command center for the Japanese Southeast Asian operations in their Burma and Malayan campaigns. Thailand would eventually declare war against the Allies on January 1942 making Bangkok a prime target for the Allied air forces.

zh.t: 第二次世界大战期间对曼谷的轰炸
zh.s: 泰国曼谷在第二次世界大战期间多次遭到盟军轰炸，因为这座城市是日军在缅甸和马来亚战役中展开东南亚行动的后勤与指挥中心，具有重要战略地位。泰国后来于1942年1月向盟国宣战，这使曼谷成为盟军航空兵的重点目标。

zh.s: 莫斯科会战发生于第二次世界大战期间的1941年10月至1942年1月，由两个具有重大战略意义的战斗阶段组成，战场位于东线一段600公里（370英里）长的战线上。苏军的防御挫败了德军对苏联首都兼最大城市莫斯科的进攻。

en.t: Thomas Mantell dies while pursuing an unidentified flying object
en.s: Kentucky Air National Guard pilot Thomas F. Mantell died on 7 January 1948 when his P-51 Mustang crashed near Franklin, Kentucky, after he was sent to investigate an unidentified flying object.
en.n: The term unidentified flying object describes the reported observation; it is not a claim of an extraterrestrial craft.

zh.t: 托马斯·曼特尔在追踪不明飞行物时坠机身亡
zh.s: 1948年1月7日，肯塔基州空中国民警卫队飞行员托马斯·F.曼特尔奉命调查一件不明飞行物。他驾驶的 P-51“野马”战斗机在肯塔基州富兰克林附近坠毁，曼特尔遇难。
zh.n: “不明飞行物”是对当时所报告观测对象的描述，并不表示它是外星飞船。

en.s: The Sverdlovsk plane crash of 7 January 1950 killed all 19 people on board, including almost the entire ice hockey team (VVS Moscow) of the Soviet Air Forces – 11 players, as well as a team doctor and a masseur. The team was on board a twin-engined Lisunov Li-2 transport aircraft, a licensed Soviet-built version of the DC-3, heading to a match against Dzerzhinets Chelyabinsk.

zh.s: 1950年1月7日，斯维尔德洛夫斯克发生空难，机上19人全部遇难，其中包括苏联空军莫斯科空军冰球队（VVS Moscow）几乎整支队伍：11名球员、一名队医和一名按摩师。球队当时乘坐一架里苏诺夫Li-2双发运输机，前往与车里雅宾斯克捷尔任涅茨队（Dzerzhinets Chelyabinsk）比赛。Li-2是苏联获授权生产的DC-3版本。

en.t: Georgetown–IBM experiment: The first public demonstration of a machine translation system is held in New York at the head office of IBM
en.s: The Georgetown–IBM experiment was an influential demonstration of machine translation, which was performed on January 7, 1954. Developed jointly by Georgetown University and IBM, the experiment involved completely automatic translation of more than sixty Russian sentences into English.

zh.t: 乔治敦大学与 IBM 在纽约公开演示机器翻译系统
zh.s: 1954年1月7日，乔治敦大学与 IBM 联合开发的机器翻译系统进行了演示。这次具有重要影响的实验将六十多个俄语句子全自动翻译成英语。

en.t: Marian Anderson makes her Metropolitan Opera debut as Ulrica
en.s: Contralto Marian Anderson made her Metropolitan Opera debut in New York on 7 January 1955, singing Ulrica in Verdi’s Un ballo in maschera. She became the first African American artist to sing a leading role with the company.
en.n: This milestone concerns a leading operatic role, rather than the first appearance of any performer of color at the Met.

zh.t: 玛丽安·安德森以乌尔丽卡一角首次登上大都会歌剧院舞台
zh.s: 1955年1月7日，女低音歌唱家玛丽安·安德森在纽约大都会歌剧院首次演出，饰演威尔第歌剧《假面舞会》中的乌尔丽卡。她成为首位在该剧院担任主要歌唱角色的非裔美国艺术家。

en.s: The Battle of Ath Yahia Moussa was an armed conflict during the Algerian War that took place on January 6, 1959, in the Kabylia region of Algeria. This battle involved the National Liberation Army (ALN) against the French Army.

zh.s: 阿特亚希亚穆萨战役是阿尔及利亚战争期间的一场武装冲突，于1959年1月6日在阿尔及利亚卡比利亚地区发生，交战双方为阿尔及利亚民族解放军（ALN）与法国军队。

en.t: The United States recognizes Cuba’s new provisional government
en.s: The United States recognized Cuba’s new provisional government on 7 January 1959 after the fall of Fulgencio Batista. The government was headed by provisional president Manuel Urrutia Lleó. Ambassador Earl E. T. Smith delivered the recognition note in Havana.
en.n: This entry concerns recognition of the provisional government headed by Urrutia; it does not describe Fidel Castro as prime minister on this date.

zh.t: 美国承认古巴新成立的临时政府
zh.s: 1959年1月7日，在富尔亨西奥·巴蒂斯塔政权倒台后，美国承认了古巴新成立的临时政府。该政府由临时总统曼努埃尔·乌鲁蒂亚·列奥领导。美国大使厄尔·E.T.史密斯在哈瓦那递交了承认该政府的照会。
zh.n: 此条记录涉及美国承认乌鲁蒂亚领导的临时政府，并未将菲德尔·卡斯特罗称为当时的总理。

en.s: The 1969 Maryland gubernatorial special election was not a direct election, but a vote in the Maryland General Assembly to determine who would assume the governorship of Maryland after Spiro Agnew's resignation, following his election to the U.S. vice presidency. At this time Maryland didn't have a position of lieutenant governor, and state law did not designate a person who would assume the office of governor in case of vacancy (unlike most states, when there is always a designated person such as lieutenant governor, Senate President or Secretary of State). In case of vacancy, the General Assembly would choose a governor. In 1969 the Assembly had a Democratic majority, so it was clear that Republican Agnew's successor would be a Democrat. The election was held on January 7, 1969.

zh.t: 1969年美国马里兰州州长特别选举
zh.s: 1969年1月7日，马里兰州议会举行州长特别选举。这不是由选民直接投票，而是由州议会决定谁来接替因当选美国副总统而辞去州长职务的斯皮罗·阿格纽。当时马里兰没有副州长一职，法律也未指定州长职位空缺时的继任者。多数其他州则会预先指定副州长、州参议院议长或州务卿等官员接任。马里兰的做法是由州议会选出州长。1969年议会由民主党占多数，因此共和党人阿格纽的继任者显然会是民主党人。

en.s: Operation Counterpunch, waged 26 September 1970 to 7 January 1971, was a military offensive of the Laotian Civil War. Royalist General Vang Pao's guerrilla army regained the vital all-weather forward fighter base at Muang Soui on the Plain of Jars from the People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN). The preemptive Counterpunch was credited with delaying an imminent PAVN wet season offensive for a month.

zh.s: “反击行动”是老挝内战期间从1970年9月26日持续至1971年1月7日的一次军事攻势。王国军将领王宝的游击队从越南人民军（PAVN）手中夺回了石缸平原芒绥的重要全天候前沿战斗机基地。这次先发制人的行动被认为使越南人民军即将展开的雨季攻势延后了一个月。

en.t: United States Senate special election in Vermont, 1972
en.s: The 1972 United States Senate special election in Vermont took place on January 7, 1972. Incumbent Republican Robert Stafford, appointed in September 1971 to fill the vacancy created by the death of Winston L. Prouty, successfully ran for re-election to the remainder of Prouty's term in the United States Senate. Stafford defeated Democratic candidate Randolph T. Major.

zh.t: 1972年美国佛蒙特州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1972年1月7日，佛蒙特州举行联邦参议员特别选举。温斯顿·L.普劳蒂去世后，共和党人罗伯特·斯塔福德于1971年9月获任填补空缺。此次他击败民主党候选人伦道夫·T.梅杰，当选完成普劳蒂剩余的参议员任期。

en.s: Iberia Flight 602 was a domestic scheduled passenger flight operated by a Sud Aviation SE 210 Caravelle that took off from Valencia, Spain, bound for the Balearic island of Ibiza, which flew into the side of a mountain near Ibiza Airport. All 98 passengers and 6 crew died in the crash.

zh.t: 伊比利亚航空602号班机空难
zh.s: 伊比利亚航空602号班机是一班西班牙国内定期客运航班，由法国南方飞机公司的SE210快帆式客机执飞，从瓦伦西亚飞往巴利阿里群岛的伊维萨岛。飞机在伊维萨机场附近撞上山体，机上98名乘客和6名机组人员全部遇难。

en.s: The Gombe Chimpanzee War, also known as the Four-Year War, was a violent conflict between two communities of chimpanzees in Gombe Stream National Park in the Kigoma region of Tanzania between 1974 and 1978. The two groups were once unified in the Kasakela community. By 1974, researcher Jane Goodall noticed the community splintering.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 贡贝黑猩猩战争又称“四年战争”，是1974年至1978年间发生在坦桑尼亚基戈马地区贡贝溪国家公园内的两个黑猩猩群体之间的暴力冲突。这两个群体原本同属卡萨凯拉族群（Kasakela）。到1974年，研究者珍·古道尔已注意到这个族群正在分裂。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.t: Vietnamese forces capture Phnom Penh and topple the Khmer Rouge government
en.s: Vietnamese forces and Cambodian allies captured Phnom Penh on 7 January 1979, overthrowing the Khmer Rouge government. Fighting continued after the capital fell; Vietnamese forces remained in Cambodia until their withdrawal in 1989.
en.n: The fall of Phnom Penh did not end the Cambodian–Vietnamese War.

zh.t: 越南军队攻占金边，推翻红色高棉政府
zh.s: 1979年1月7日，越南军队及其柬埔寨盟军攻占金边，推翻红色高棉政府。首都失守后，战斗仍在继续；越南军队一直驻留柬埔寨，直至1989年撤军。
zh.n: 金边陷落并未结束柬越战争。

en.t: Jimmy Carter signs the Chrysler loan-guarantee law
en.s: President Jimmy Carter signed the Chrysler Corporation Loan Guarantee Act of 1979 on 7 January 1980 at the White House. The law authorized up to $1.5 billion in federal guarantees for loans from private sources, subject to additional financial commitments or concessions from other participants in the rescue package.
en.n: The measure authorized loan guarantees; it was not a direct $1.5 billion government loan or grant.

zh.t: 吉米·卡特签署克莱斯勒贷款担保法
zh.s: 1980年1月7日，美国总统吉米·卡特在白宫签署《1979年克莱斯勒公司贷款担保法》。该法授权联邦政府为私人资金来源提供的贷款作出最高15亿美元的担保，条件是救助方案的其他参与方另外作出资金承诺或让步。
zh.n: 这项措施授权提供贷款担保，并非由政府直接发放15亿美元贷款或补助。

en.t: Japan launches the Sakigake interplanetary probe
en.s: Japan’s Institute of Space and Astronautical Science launched Sakigake from Kagoshima Space Center at Uchinoura on 7 January 1985 UTC, corresponding to 8 January in Japan. The spacecraft entered a heliocentric orbit to test technology for later interplanetary missions and study the solar wind and interplanetary environment.
en.n: January 7 is the UTC launch date; the ISAS mission archive lists January 8, 1985 in Japan Standard Time.

zh.t: 日本发射“先驱号”行星际探测器
zh.s: 日本宇宙科学研究所于协调世界时1985年1月7日，即日本当地时间1月8日，从内之浦的鹿儿岛宇宙空间观测所发射“先驱号”。探测器进入绕太阳运行的轨道，为后续行星际任务验证技术，并研究太阳风及行星际环境。
zh.n: 1月7日为发射的协调世界时日期；宇宙科学研究所的任务档案采用日本标准时间1985年1月8日。

en.s: General elections were held in Aruba on 7 January 1989. The People's Electoral Movement (MEP) emerged as the largest party, winning ten of the 21 seats in the Estates. The MEP formed a three-party coalition government with the Aruban Democratic Party and the Aruban Patriotic Party, with Nelson Oduber becoming prime minister.

zh.s: 1989年1月7日，阿鲁巴举行大选。人民选举运动取得议会21席中的十席，成为最大党。该党与阿鲁巴民主党、阿鲁巴爱国党组成三党联合政府，纳尔逊·奥杜韦尔出任总理。

en.s: Sutton United 2–1 Coventry City was a football match played on 7 January 1989 at Gander Green Lane, Sutton. The match was an FA Cup Third Round tie. It is one of the most famous 'giant-killings' in the competition's history, notable for being one of those rare occasions when a club from the highest tier of English football was defeated by a non-League side.

zh.s: 1989年1月7日，萨顿联与考文垂城在萨顿的甘德格林巷球场进行一场足总杯第三轮比赛，萨顿联以2比1获胜。这是赛事历史上最著名的以弱胜强之战之一，也是顶级联赛球队罕见地败给英格兰足球联赛（Football League）之外球队的例子。

en.t: Upon the death of Emperor Hirohito on 7 January 1989, Akihito acceded to the throne, becoming the 125th Emperor of Japan
en.s: Akihito (born 23 December 1933) is a member of the Imperial House of Japan who reigned as the 125th emperor of Japan from 7 January 1989 until his abdication on 30 April 2019. The era of his rule was named the Heisei era, Heisei being an expression of achieving peace worldwide. Akihito was born as the fifth child and first son of Emperor Hirohito and Empress Kōjun.

zh.t: 昭和天皇于1989年1月7日去世后，明仁继位，成为日本第125代天皇
zh.s: 明仁生于1933年12月23日，是日本皇室成员，自1989年1月7日起担任日本第125代天皇，直至2019年4月30日退位。在位期间的年号为“平成”，寓意天下和平。他是昭和天皇裕仁与香淳皇后的第五个孩子、长子。

en.s: On 7 January 1993, the Army of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina attacked the Bosnian Serb village of Kravica from the Srebrenica enclave. The date coincided with Serbian Orthodox Christmas. Accounts cited by the article report 41–48 Serb deaths, including 30–35 soldiers and 11–13 civilians.

zh.s: 1993年1月7日，波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那共和国军从斯雷布雷尼察飞地出发，袭击了波黑塞族村庄克拉维察。当天恰逢塞尔维亚东正教圣诞节。条目引述的资料记载，塞族一方有41至48人死亡，包括30至35名军人和11至13名平民。

en.t: Ghana’s Fourth Republic begins as Jerry Rawlings takes office
en.s: Jerry Rawlings took office as president of Ghana on 7 January 1993, the same day that the new constitution came into effect and the Fourth Republic began. The inauguration followed his victory in the 1992 presidential election.
en.n: This entry records the constitutional inauguration, rather than Rawlings’s earlier military rule.

zh.t: 杰里·罗林斯就任总统，加纳第四共和国开始
zh.s: 1993年1月7日，杰里·罗林斯就任加纳总统。同一天，新宪法生效，加纳第四共和国开始。此次就职是在他赢得1992年总统选举后举行的。
zh.n: 此条记录涉及新宪法下的总统就职，并非罗林斯此前的军事统治。

en.s: United Express Flight 6291 was a regularly scheduled United Express flight from Dulles International Airport near Washington, D.C. to Port Columbus International Airport in Columbus, Ohio. It was a service operated by Atlantic Coast Airlines on behalf of United Express. Late on the night of January 7, 1994, the British Aerospace Jetstream 41 operating as Flight 6291 stalled and crashed on approach to Port Columbus International Airport.

zh.s: 联合快运6291号班机是从华盛顿特区附近的杜勒斯国际机场，飞往俄亥俄州哥伦布港国际机场的定期航班，由大西洋海岸航空代表联合快运运营。1994年1月7日深夜，执飞的英国宇航捷流41客机，在进近哥伦布港国际机场时失速坠毁。

en.s: The 1996 Heineken Cup Final was the final match of the 1995–96 Heineken Cup, the inaugural season of Europe's top club rugby union competition. The match was played on 7 January 1996 at the Arms Park in Cardiff. The match was contested by Cardiff of Wales and Toulouse of France. Toulouse won the match 21–18 after extra time; they took the lead with two tries in the first 10 minutes, but the kicking of Adrian Davies kept Cardiff level.

zh.s: 1996年喜力杯决赛是1995至1996赛季喜力杯的最后一场比赛，该赛季也是这项欧洲顶级俱乐部15人制橄榄球赛事的首个赛季。决赛于1996年1月7日在卡迪夫的阿姆斯公园球场举行，由威尔士卡迪夫队对阵法国图卢兹队。图卢兹经加时赛以21比18获胜；他们在开场10分钟内两次达阵取得领先，但卡迪夫凭借阿德里安·戴维斯的踢球得分与对手战成平手。

en.s: Guilty as Charged (2001) was the third and final Guilty as Charged professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Extreme Championship Wrestling (ECW). en.s: New Year's Revolution (2007) was the third annual and final New Year's Revolution professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE). It took place on January 7, 2007, at Kemper Arena in Kansas City, Missouri and featured wrestlers and other talent from WWE's Raw brand. There were seven professional wrestling matches scheduled on the event's card. Four championships exclusive to the Raw brand were contested for; none was lost as all four championships were retained. zh.s: 2007年1月7日，世界摔角娱乐（WWE）在美国密苏里州堪萨斯城的肯珀竞技场举办第三届年度“新年革命”按次付费职业摔角赛。这也是原年度系列的最后一届，由Raw品牌的选手及其他表演人员参加。当晚安排七场比赛，Raw独有的四项冠军头衔均接受挑战，但全部由卫冕者保住。压轴赛是一场常规摔角比赛，WWE冠军约翰·塞纳击败挑战者乌玛嘎，成功卫冕。

en.s: Operation Shahi Tandar, also called Operation Atal, was a series of operations by Coalition troops from the British 42 Commando Royal Marines, Royal Canadian Regiment, 2-2 United States Infantry, and the Afghan national military in central Helmand province and the Western Panjwayi and Western Zhari districts of Kandahar, Afghanistan from January 7–31, 2009. One raid targeted a Taliban bomb-making factory in the Khakrez and Shah Wali Khot districts of Kandahar, Afghanistan January 7–9, 2009. In the raid, conducted by helicopter and armored vehicles, the coalition troops seized six large tubs of explosives along with 38 pressure plates used to detonate hidden mines.

zh.s: 2009年1月7日至31日，英国皇家海军陆战队第42突击队、加拿大皇家团、美国步兵第2团第2营，以及阿富汗国防军，在阿富汗赫尔曼德省中部、坎大哈省潘杰瓦伊西部和扎里西部展开一系列行动，称为“沙希雷霆”行动，又称“阿塔尔”行动。其中1月7日至9日的一次突袭，针对坎大哈省哈克雷兹和沙阿瓦利科特地区的塔利班炸弹工厂。联军利用直升机和装甲车辆实施突袭，缴获六大桶炸药及38块用于引爆隐蔽地雷的压力板。

en.s: Strikeforce Challengers: Woodley vs. Saffiedine was held at Nashville Municipal Auditorium in Nashville, Tennessee, on 7 January 2011. Tyron Woodley defeated Tarec Saffiedine by unanimous decision in the main event.

zh.t: Strikeforce 挑战者赛：伍德利对萨菲丁
zh.s: 2011年1月7日，Strikeforce 挑战者赛“伍德利对萨菲丁”在美国田纳西州纳什维尔市政礼堂举行。头条主赛中，泰伦·伍德利以一致判定击败塔雷克·萨菲丁。
zh.n: 此日期对应这场具名赛事，并非整个2011年的赛事日程。

en.s: On 7 January 2012, a scenic hot air balloon flight from Carterton, New Zealand, collided with a high voltage power line while attempting to land, causing it to catch fire, disintegrate and crash just north of the town, killing all eleven people (ten passengers and the pilot) on board. An inquiry into the accident by the Transport Accident Investigation Commission (TAIC) concluded that the balloon pilot made an error of judgement when contact with the power lines became imminent, trying to out-climb the power lines rather than using the rapid descent system to drop the balloon quickly to the ground below.

zh.t: 2012年新西兰卡特顿热气球坠毁事故
zh.s: 2012年1月7日，新西兰卡特顿一架观光热气球在尝试降落时撞上高压电线，随后起火、解体，坠落在镇北。机上十名乘客和一名驾驶员全部遇难。交通事故调查委员会认定，当热气球即将触碰电线时，驾驶员判断失误：他试图升高越过电线，而没有使用快速下降系统，让热气球尽快降到下方地面。

en.s: On 7 January 2015, at about 11:30 a.m. in Paris, France, the employees of the French satirical weekly magazine Charlie Hebdo were targeted in a terrorist shooting attack by two French-born Algerian Muslim brothers, Saïd Kouachi and Chérif Kouachi. Armed with rifles and other weapons, the duo murdered 12 people and injured 11 others; they identified themselves as members of al-Qaeda in the Arabian Peninsula, which claimed responsibility for the attack.

en.s: On 7 January 2019, members of the Armed Forces of Gabon announced a coup d'état in Gabon. en.t: Palestinian militants and Palestinian Authority forces clash in the West Bank
en.s: Armed clashes involving Palestinian militants and Palestinian Authority forces were reported in Jenin and the Balata refugee camp on 7 January 2022 amid protests against the Authority. The article links the unrest to the violent arrest of Ahmed Zubeidi by Palestinian police in Jenin.
en.n: This entry records the dated clashes described in the source, without assigning a precise beginning to all hostility between the groups.

zh.t: 巴勒斯坦武装人员与巴勒斯坦民族权力机构部队在约旦河西岸交火
zh.s: 据报道，2022年1月7日，在反对巴勒斯坦民族权力机构的抗议活动期间，巴勒斯坦武装人员与该机构部队在杰宁和巴拉塔难民营发生武装冲突。原文将这次骚乱与巴勒斯坦警察在杰宁暴力逮捕艾哈迈德·祖贝迪一事联系起来。
zh.n: 此条记录涉及原文所述当天的冲突，并未将双方所有敌对行动的起点精确限定在这一天。

en.s: The 2021 UAE Super Cup was the 14th professional and 20th overall UAE Super Cup, an annual football match played between the winners of the previous season's League and President's Cup. It was played between Al Jazira who won the league on the final day of the season and Shabab Al Ahli who defeated Al Nasr in the President's cup final.

zh.s: 2021年阿联酋超级杯是职业化后的第14届、总计第20届阿联酋超级杯。这项年度足球赛事由上一赛季的联赛冠军与总统杯冠军交锋。本届参赛双方分别是联赛末轮夺冠的阿布扎比半岛队，以及在总统杯决赛中击败迪拜胜利队的迪拜青年国民队。

en.s: Blood and Thunder (2023) was a professional wrestling supercard event produced by Major League Wrestling (MLW), which took place on January 7, 2023 at the 2300 Arena in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. It was the third event under the MLW Blood and Thunder chronology, and also featured wrestlers from the Dragon Gate promotion.

zh.s: 2023年1月7日，职业摔角大联盟（MLW）在美国宾夕法尼亚州费城的2300竞技场，举办由多场重点对决组成的“血与雷”大型赛事。这是MLW该系列的第三届，也有来自Dragon Gate组织的选手参加。

en.t: The longest U.S. House of Representatives speaker election since the December 1859 – February 1860 U.S. speaker election concludes and Kevin McCarthy is elected 55th Speaker of the United States House of Representatives
en.s: Kevin Owen McCarthy (born January 26, 1965) is an American politician who served as the 55th speaker of the United States House of Representatives from January to October 2023. A member of the Republican Party, he represented California's 22nd congressional district from 2007 to 2013, followed by California's 23rd congressional district from 2013 to 2023, and finally California's 20th congressional district in 2023 before resigning from the House of Representatives the same year.

zh.t: 美国众议院议长选举历经自1859年12月至1860年2月那次选举以来最长的选举过程后结束，凯文·麦卡锡当选第55任议长
zh.s: 凯文·欧文·麦卡锡生于1965年1月26日，是美国政治人物，曾于2023年1月至10月担任第55任美国众议院议长。他是共和党人，2007年至2013年代表加利福尼亚州第22国会选区，2013年至2023年代表该州第23选区，2023年改为代表第20选区，并于同年辞去众议员职务。

en.s: General elections were held in Bangladesh on 7 January 2024 in accordance with the constitutional requirement, stating that elections must take place within the 90-day period before the expiration of the current term of the Jatiya Sangsad on 29 January 2024. The Awami League, led by incumbent Sheikh Hasina, won the election for the fourth consecutive time with less than 40% of the eligible voters voting according to an Election Commission, which was run by the ruling political party.

zh.s: 2024年1月7日，孟加拉国举行大选。宪法规定，选举必须在本届国民议会于2024年1月29日任期届满前的90天内举行。现任总理谢赫·哈西娜领导的人民联盟连续第四次获胜。由执政党掌控的选举委员会公布，合资格选民的投票率低于40%。

en.s: The 2022–23 Tunisian Super Cup was the 18th edition of the Tunisian Super Cup. The match was contested by the 2022–23 Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1 champions, Étoile du Sahel and the Tunisian Cup winners, Olympique Béja. The match took place at Stade Hammadi Agrebi in Tunis on 7 January 2024.

zh.s: 2022—2023赛季突尼斯超级杯是第18届突尼斯超级杯。参赛双方是该赛季突尼斯甲级联赛冠军沙希尔星队与突尼斯杯冠军贝贾奥林匹克队。比赛于2024年1月7日在突尼斯市的哈马迪·阿格雷比体育场举行。

en.s: The 2025 New Year's Evil was a professional wrestling television special produced by WWE for its developmental brand NXT. It was the fifth annual NXT: New Year's Evil and sixth New Year's Evil overall. It took place on January 7, 2025, at the Shrine Expo Hall in Los Angeles, California and aired live as a special episode of NXT on The CW.

zh.s: 2025年1月7日，WWE为旗下培养新人的NXT品牌，在美国加利福尼亚州洛杉矶的神殿博览馆制作职业摔角特别节目“新年恶夜”。这是NXT连续第五年举办该年度赛事，若计入早期同名赛事则为第六届。CW电视网将其作为《NXT》特别一期进行现场直播。

en.s: From January 7 to 31, 2025, 14 destructive wildfires affected the Los Angeles metropolitan area and San Diego County in California, United States. The fires were exacerbated by drought conditions, low humidity, a buildup of vegetation from the previous winter, and hurricane-force Santa Ana winds, which in some places reached 100 miles per hour (160 km/h; 45 m/s).
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2025年1月7日至31日，美国加利福尼亚州洛杉矶都会区及圣迭戈县遭遇14场破坏性山火。干旱、低湿度、前一个冬季生长并积聚的植被，以及达到飓风强度的圣安娜风，使火势更加严重。部分地点的风速达到每小时100英里（160公里，约每秒45米）。
